description.value: Small private campground in Jordan River offering sea views and rainforest surroundings with fewer than 20 unserviced tent sites; tidy facilities including a heated shower and full bathroom, right on the Sooke–Port Renfrew cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and corroborates OSM tags well. The site confirms tents-only, fewer than 20 unserviced sites, a heated shower and full bathroom, drinking water (OSM drinking_water=yes), and year-round operation. Phone and email match OSM exactly; the address appears only as a Plus Code on the website while OSM has no address field populated, so address confirmation is null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Sooke' but the campground is in Jordan River, BC — a distinct community roughly 30 km west of Sooke.
No civic street address in OSM; website provides only a Plus Code (CWGR+VF) rather than a standard address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate year-round tent campground on southern Vancouver Island's coastal cycling route with confirmed showers and potable water; clear value for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: right on the Sooke–Port Renfrew cycling corridor... heated shower and full bathroom
